server_settings.title: Server settings
server_settings.port_restart_note: Changing the port while running will require a restart.
server_settings.name: Name
server_settings._comment_max_players: Maximum number of players allowed, admins can join even a full server. 0 means unlimited.
server_settings._comment_visibility: Public: Game will be published on the official Factorio matching server. Lan: Game will be broadcast on LAN
server_settings._comment_credentials: Your factorio.com login credentials. Required for games with visibility public
server_settings._comment_token: Authentication token. May be used instead of 'password' above.
server_settings._comment_require_user_verification: When set to true, the server will only allow clients that have a valid Factorio.com account
server_settings._comment_max_upload_in_kilobytes_per_sec: Optional, default value is 0. 0 means unlimited.
server_settings.max_upload_in_kilobytes_per_second: Max upload in kilobytes per second
server_settings._comment_max_upload_slots: Optional, default value is 5. 0 means unlimited.
server_settings._comment_minimum_latency_in_ticks: Optional one tick is 16ms in default speed, default value is 0. 0 means no minimum.
server_settings._comment_max_heartbeats_per_second: Network tick rate. Maximum rate game updates packets are sent at before bundling them together. Minimum value is 6, maximum value is 240.
server_settings._comment_ignore_player_limit_for_returni: Players that played on this map already can join even when the max player limit was reached.
server_settings.ignore_player_limit_for_returning_player: Ignore player limit for returning players
server_settings._comment_allow_commands: Possible values are: true, false and admins-only
server_settings._comment_autosave_slots: Server autosave slots, it is cycled through when the server autosaves.
server_settings._comment_afk_autokick_interval: How many minutes until someone is kicked when doing nothing, 0 for never.
server_settings._comment_auto_pause: Whether should the server be paused when no players are present.
server_settings._comment_auto_pause_when_players_connect: Whether should the server be paused when someone is connecting to the server.
server_settings.only_admins_can_pause_the_game: Only admins can pause the game
server_settings._comment_autosave_only_on_server: Whether autosaves should be saved only on server or also on all connected clients. Default is true.
server_settings._comment_non_blocking_saving: Highly experimental feature, enable only at your own risk of losing your saves. On UNIX systems, server will fork itself to create an autosave. Autosaving on connected Windows clients will be disabled regardless of autosave_only_on_server option.
server_settings._comment_segment_sizes: Long network messages are split into segments that are sent over multiple ticks. Their size depends on the number of peers currently connected. Increasing the segment size will increase upload bandwidth requirement for the server and download bandwidth requirement for clients. This setting only affects server outbound messages. Changing these settings can have a negative impact on connection stability for some clients.

mods.mod_library_help:
Mod Library is shared storage for mod files. Upload a mod ZIP once — then assign it to any server via manifest.

1. Upload a ZIP or import from Mod Portal
2. Add mods to manifest using + button
3. Preview changes before applying
4. Apply — deploys mods to server folder

Server must be stopped before applying.

help.title: Help
help.fsm_content: The Factorio Server Manager (FSM) is an open source project and is not affiliated to the game Factorio or Wube Software.
help.bugs_help_content: Please use the <0>GitHub repository</0> to report bugs or seek for help.
help.quickstart_intro: From an empty install to a running server, step by step.
help.qs1_text_linux: Open the Servers page. In the Create server form pick stable, experimental or a specific version and press Download. FSM downloads the headless server by itself.
help.qs1_text_win: FSM cannot download Factorio on Windows. Run prepare-factorio.bat next to factorio-server-manager.exe: it takes bin\x64 from your Factorio client (Steam, or a client zip placed next to the script) and downloads the matching headless data. Then reload this page; the version appears in the Create server form. Stop all servers before running it again.
help.qs2_text: Servers page, Create server form: name, port and version, then Create. Each server gets its own instance folder with saves, mods, config and logs. Bind IP is always saved as 0.0.0.0.
help.qs3_text: Open the server, Saves tab, upload a .zip save. Without a save the server will create nothing to load, so upload or generate one first.
help.qs4_text: Mods tab, Sync, select the save. Match save enables the mods the save needs and disables the rest; Add from save only enables. Missing mods are downloaded (portal login required) or taken from the library. Then check the Apply window and press Apply.
help.qs5_text: Press Start on the server card. Stopped (red), Starting (orange), Running (green) once RCON is connected. The server must be stopped to change mods.
help.qs6_text: Players connect to the host IP and the server UDP port. Open that UDP port in the firewall (on Windows: inbound rule for UDP, e.g. 34197) and forward it on the router for internet play.
help.qs7_text: Saves tab, backup schedule and retention. Backups are stored outside the instance, so they survive a wipe.
help.howto1_text: Servers tab -> create form. Pick a version and a name. Bind IP is always saved as 0.0.0.0, the real address is shown for information only. Each server gets its own instance folder with saves, mods, config and logs.
help.howto2_text: Open the server, Saves tab, upload a .zip. Select it, then use Sync on the Mods tab to pull the mods the save needs.
help.howto3_text: Sync button has two modes. Match save: enables the mods from the save, disables all others and applies automatically. Add from save: only enables what the save needs, nothing is disabled. If the library has another version of a mod, the one from the save wins in the manifest.
help.howto4_title: Mod library and the trash can
help.howto4_text: The library keeps every uploaded or downloaded version. Toggles and Apply only change the server manifest and the instance folder. Only the trash can removes a mod from the library physically.
help.howto5_text: Any manifest change shows an Apply window: To Add, To Remove, To Enable, To Disable. Untick items to skip them. Cancel resets the manifest to what is deployed. The server must be stopped to apply.
help.howto6_text: Backups are stored outside instances (fsm-data/backups/<serverID>), so they survive a wipe unless you tick the backups option. Backups of other servers are shown dimmed and can be restored into the current one. Schedule and retention are configured on the same tab.
help.howto7_text: Set an interval in server settings (seconds, 0 = off). FSM checks the server every few seconds and restarts it if it died.
help.dz_desc: Deletes the selected data of one server. The server must be stopped. Backups are kept unless you tick the backups option. The mod library is never touched.
help.dz_full: Delete server completely (instance, manifest, catalog entry)
help.dz_backups: Also wipe backups of this server
help.dz_sure: Are you sure? Backups will be deleted permanently and cannot be restored.
